user.title: APsystems ECU (SunSpec Modbus)
user.description: Enable SunSpec on the ECU first (EMA Manager, ECU app, Workspace, Modbus Configuration) and give every inverter a Modbus address. The integration then scans the addresses and detects the inverters, their AC topology, the DC block and the available controls.

data_description.ecu_id: The 12 digits on the ECU label or in EMA. The ECU is not visible over Modbus: its ID gives the device its name and model (215… ECU-C, 2160… ECU-R, 2162… ECU-R Pro).

confirm.title: Detected installation

reconfigure.title: Detect again
reconfigure.description: Scans the ECU again, for example after adding inverters or changing their addresses in EMA.

data_description.ecu_id: The 12 digits on the ECU label or in EMA. The ECU is not visible over Modbus: its ID gives the device its name and model (215… ECU-C, 2160… ECU-R, 2162… ECU-R Pro).

error.cannot_connect: No answer on this host and port. Check the address and that SunSpec is switched on in the ECU settings.
error.no_inverters: The ECU answers but no inverter was found. Check that the inverters have Modbus addresses in the ECU settings, and the highest address to scan.
error.adapter_unsupported: This is the bolkedebruin/apsystems-sunspec adapter (usually port 1502), not the ECU's own SunSpec server. It is not supported yet: use port 502.

data.limit_keepalive: Rewrite the last power limit every (s), 0 = off
